description: This script manages the lifecycle of the SSH daemon (sshd) on a device, including starting, stopping, and handling status events related to LAN, WAN, and bridge components. It also ensures SSH host keys are generated if missing and manages necessary permissions.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Starts the SSH daemon, generates host keys if missing, and prepares necessary directories and permissions.

methods.name: do_stop
methods.description: Stops the SSH daemon if it is running.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Handles starting the SSH service, including logging, configuration, and status updates.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Handles stopping the SSH service, including logging and status updates.

methods.name: service_lanwan_status
methods.description: Checks LAN and WAN status and restarts or stops SSH service accordingly.

methods.name: service_bridge_status
methods.description: Checks bridge status and manages SSH service accordingly.
